t: Conmen Case Files: The Conman Kid – Aged Just 13
d: This 13-year-old pulled off almost half a million dollars worth of fraud, often selling goods that didn’t exist.

t: Conmen Case Files: Michael Hammond – The Fantasist Con
d: He posed as a playboy, a detective, a top surgeon, millionaire property developer, royal confident and boyfriend of Renee Zellweger.

t: Conmen Case Files: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman
st: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman
d: Golightly conned tens of thousands of dollars from men she found in lonely hearts columns and dating sites.

t: 72 Hours: The Great Despisers
d: A 19 year old man comes home one night to discover that his family had all been savagely murdered. Could it be the insurance money and a movie called "The Great Despisers" that motivated the killers to perpetrate such violence?

t: 72 Hours: Model Killer
d: A gorgeous young model is bludgeoned to death in her downtown apartment. The wounds to her head are so severe police initially presume she's been shot.

t: 72 Hours: Thrill Kill
d: When a senior citizen is killed on a city street, authorities at first treat it as a typical hit-and-run accident. But as they investigate further, they begin to realize that the culprit is a thrill-seeking psychopath.

t: 72 Hours: Evil Eyes
d: A dead woman is found in a park. It’s learned the deceased is a divorced landlady of a group home for transients. The suspect list is long; the clues to follow are few.

t: 72 Hours: Kidnapped
d: A wealthy Asian girl is kidnapped in Vancouver. When the kidnappers make the fateful error of using the young girl’s cell phone, police are able to track their movements and capture the assailants.

t: 72 Hours: Good Doctor
d: A single mother in Saskatchewan visits a hospital in the midst of a panic attack. Her doctor sedates her. Then, she is certain, he rapes her.

t: 72 Hours: Six Feet Under
d: In a Toronto suburb during the summer of 1996, a man leaves home for a business trip. He doesn’t return. Fearing foul play, his desperate wife finally reports her husband’s disappearance to the police.

t: 72 Hours: Dead End
d: A young couple hits the road, hitchhiking across North America. Free spirits keen to explore the world. When the young woman stops phoning home, her father is alarmed.

t: 72 Hours: Vanished
d: A small town public school teacher fails to arrive for work for the first time in thirty years, leaving an empty house and a baffled community.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
d: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
d: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case
d: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case
st: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case
d: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Victims of a Sadist - Cyril Koskinas Case
st: Victims of a Sadist - Cyril Koskinas Case
d: On July 19th 2004, the naked and tied up body of a woman is recovered in the Ourcq canal in Fresnes-sur-Marne. The victim is impossible to identify.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
st: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
d: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
d: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Ste´phane Kameugne Case)
st: A Fatal Student Night (Ste´phane Kameugne Case)
d: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school

t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
d: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

t: Copycat Killers
d: Jeffrey Dahmer, inspired by The Exorcist III, becomes the infamous Milwaukee Cannibal.
